n: Galiano 48-Inch Freestanding Dual Fuel Range, 8 Burners, Double Convection Ovens
desc: The Galiano 48" Dual Fuel Range blends professional style and performance with a durable stainless steel design. Featuring eight sealed burners with a total output of 107,000 BTU, including a powerful 20,000 BTU dual-ring burner for boiling or searing, it gently simmers delicate foods, such as chocolate and sauces.
hl: Includes 1 Sealed Dual-Ring Burner to achieve high heat searing or delicate simmering control
Recessed Black Enamel Cooktop Cavity contains spills for quick clean-ups
4.32 Cu.Ft True Convection Fan Oven with 6,300 Watt Total Broil and Bake output, additional 2.26 Cu.Ft. Oven with a 3,400 Watt Total Broil and Bake output.
8 Sealed Burners combine a total -top output of 107,000 BTU
Continuous Cast Iron Grates provide even heat distribution and stable pots and allow for cookware and mobility off heat source
Insulated Oven Doors with 3-Layer Glass Windows and Smooth Friction Hinges
